metadata.case_name: RAI JUN PRASAD v. PACIFIC CROWN SECURITY SERVICES LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: working for a restaurant in a marketing capacity

injuries.description: supraspinatus tendinosis with adhesive capsulitis secondary to previous right shoulder injury
source:
“ The clinical diagnosis was supraspinatus tendinosis with adhesive
capsulitis secondary to previous right shoulder injury.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of the left knee
source: Both doctors agreed that Mr Prasad suffered soft tissue injuries to his right shoulder, left knee, left buttock and lower back as a result of the fall on 19 August 2013.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at lower leg level

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of the left buttock
source: Both doctors agreed that Mr Prasad suffered soft tissue injuries to his right shoulder, left knee, left buttock and lower back as a result of the fall on 19 August 2013.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: disc bulge at L3/4 level of the lumbar spine and an encysted ganglion abutting the ACL and PCL
source: an MRI revealed a sub acromial and sub deltoid bursitis over the right shoulder, a disc bulge at L3/4 level of the lumbar spine and an encysted ganglion abutting the ACL and PCL.

manifestations.description: right shoulder stiffness and pain; limited movement of his right shoulder
pain on prolonged walking and standing and lifting heavy objects
pain over left knee and left buttock

treatments_received: Outpatient physiotherapy at Queen Elizabeth Hospital (from 17 September 2013 until January 2014)
Second course of physiotherapy (began March 2014; discharged June 2014)

losses.description: Right shoulder stiffness, pain and limited movement of his right shoulder
Pain on prolonged walking and standing and difficulty lifting heavy objects
Unable to return to his former occupation as a construction site rigger
